newsitem.title: USA: Boise Cascade cites unfavorable paper market.
newsitem.headline: Boise Cascade cites unfavorable paper market.

text.p: Boise Cascade Corp Chairman and Chief Executive Officer George Harad said Monday that results for the 1996 fourth quarter and full year reflect unfavorable market conditions in the paper business, partially offset by good results in office and building products.
For early 1997, paper prices remain depressed and the strength of office products distribution is likely to be offset by seasonal weakness in building products, he said.
As a result, he does not anticipate much change in Boise Cascade's overall results early in the year.
Harad said Boise Cascade's performance should improve as the year progresses, assuming moderate economic growth in the U.S. and overseas.
He sees continued profitable growth in the office products distribution business and increasing contribution from an engineered wood products plant in Alexandria, La.
Start-up of a paper machine at its Jackson, Alabama, mill should add to the earning capacity of the paper business, he said.
